description: Implementation of the WindowManagerConnector class, managing window display creation, registration, and display info retrieval within the WPEFramework plugin.

classes.name: WindowManagerConnector

classes.name: WindowManagerNotification
classes.description: Handles window manager notifications, such as user inactivity.
